statement: INSERT INTO workspace.mlpabfc7056.scoresbedd56 (account_id, score) WITH src AS (SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) AS event_time, CAST(f1 AS DOUBLE) AS f1, CAST(f2 AS DOUBLE) AS f2, CAST(f3 AS DOUBLE) AS f3 FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabfc7056/raw/feature_history.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)), latest AS (SELECT account_id, f1, f2, f3, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) AS rn FROM src WHERE event_time <= 1773313200000) SELECT account_id, ROUND(1.0/(1.0+EXP(-((-0.8177)*f1 + 1.3331*f2 + 0.0176*f3 + (-0.2971)))), 6) AS score FROM latest WHERE rn = 1
